resources.string: Links will open in your browser unless you allow us to open them.
Android restricts which apps can open links by default (and it is good that they do!). For Onetune this means that we cannot open streaming links directly. But you can configure that.
1. Tap Open settings below, then \"Add link\", and select the links you want Onetune to open.
2. If the service\'s own app is installed, remove these links from its \"Open by default\" settings. E.g., if you have Spotify installed, remove the open.spotify.com link.
Resolve and share links through your own server
Leave empty to use the default server. Links you share will point to this server.
Enter a https address like https://onetune.example.org
Open in search only (no exact match found)
To skip this step, pick a default service in %1$s.
